subject: english
stem: This exchange happens near the school entrance. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: an offer to store the paint boxes in the art room
a question about when the paint boxes arrived at the art room
a request to move the paint boxes to the art room
a request to move the paint boxes to the health center

optionRationales.reason: an offer to store the paint boxes in the art room：此項把「a request to move the paint boxes to」改成「an offer to store the paint boxes in」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。

a question about when the paint boxes arrived at the art room：此項把「request to move the paint boxes to」改成「question about when the paint boxes arrived at」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。
a request to move the paint boxes to the art room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。

a request to move the paint boxes to the health center：此項把「art room」改成「health center」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the paint boxes to the art room」。
